plugin.name: Documents
plugin.description: Templates with blanks to fill, documents written from them, signed and revised; series in a file.
field.text.hint: A blank to fill: {{?name | type, unit, min~max, required, default=…}}. Types: text, longtext, number, date, time, yesno, choice: a/b, multi: a/b.
field.levels.hint: One per line or separated by /, e.g. Written / Reviewed
field.order.hint: An item's name (e.g. Time); empty: when written
item.error.name: {item}: the name may hold letters, digits and _ (at most 40)
item.error.options: {item}: list the choices after the colon, separated by /
item.error.unknown: {item}: something in it is not understood
doc.chooseTemplate: Choose the template to write from.
doc.fromTemplate: From “{name}”: its text comes over when you save.
template.preview: Preview (in this tab's environment; nothing is kept)
sign.outOfRange: Outside the range: {list}. Sign again to sign anyway.
sign.locked: It is signed: revise it to change it.
revise.void: A void document cannot be revised.
revise.noReason: Write the reason for revising first.
revise.done: Back to draft: the signatures are taken off.
series.empty: Nothing in it yet: “Add one” writes one from the template.
sign.saveFirst: Save it first (⌘S): a document is signed as it is saved.
conv.document: A document is written from its template; once signed it cannot be changed; revising it needs a reason; a void one is kept as it was.
